Package com.senzing.sdk.core.auto

Class SzAutoCoreEnvironment

java.lang.Object
com.senzing.sdk.core.SzCoreEnvironment
com.senzing.sdk.core.auto.SzAutoCoreEnvironment
All Implemented Interfaces:
SzAutoEnvironment, SzEnvironment
public class SzAutoCoreEnvironment extends SzCoreEnvironment implements SzAutoEnvironment
Extends SzCoreEnvironment to provide a more robust implementation for instances used in long-running processes typically in server-side applications. The features added by this implementation are:
  • Optional basic retry logic to retry any Senzing Core SDK method that fails with an SzRetryableException. The method may be retried one or more times with an increasing delay between retry attempts.
  • Optional automatic configuration refresh so that the active configuration ID remains in sync with the current default configuration ID.
  • When automatic configuration refresh is enabled, this implementation automatically refreshes the configuration when a Senzing Core SDK method annotated as SzConfigRetryable fails with an SzException, subsequently retrying that method if in fact the the active configuration was changed.
  • Optional isolation of all Senzing Core SDK operations to an execution thread pool to enhance performance by reusing cached thread-local resources while preventing excessive memory usage that could occur when executing Senzing operations in too many threads.
  • A limited ExecutorService-like interface to enable executing multiple Senzing Core SDK operations within the execution thread pool while preventing excessive context switching.

  • Method Details

    • newAutoBuilder

      public static SzAutoCoreEnvironment.Builder newAutoBuilder()
      Creates a new instance of SzAutoCoreEnvironment.Builder for setting up an instance of SzAutoCoreEnvironment. Keep in mind that while multiple SzAutoCoreEnvironment.Builder instances can exists, only one active instance of SzCoreEnvironment (including any of its derived classes) can exist at time. An active instance is one that has not yet been destroyed.

      NOTE: The static method SzCoreEnvironment.newBuilder() will produce an instance of SzCoreEnvironment.Builder which will only create instances of SzCoreEnvironment rather than SzAutoCoreEnvironment.

      Alternatively, you can directly call the Builder() constructor.

      Returns:
      The SzAutoCoreEnvironment.Builder for configuring and initializing the SzAutoCoreEnvironment.

    • ensureConfigCurrent

      protected boolean ensureConfigCurrent() throws SzException
      Protected method to ensure the active configuration ID is the same as the default configuration ID. This will check if they are out of sync and, if so, reinitialize with the default configuration ID. This will attempt to handle the unlikely (though possible) race conditions by rechecking several times that they are in sync after reinitializing.
      Returns:
      true if the active configuration ID was updated to the default configuration ID, otherwise false if no update was necessary.
      Throws:
      SzException - If a failure occurs.

    • destroy

      public void destroy()
      Overridden to ensure that if the configuration refresh is proactive that the background thread that handles periodic refresh is shutdown before destroying the environment.

      Further, this override will ensure that all threads in the execution thread pool (if any) are destroyed after the environment is destroyed.

      Specified by:
      destroy in interface SzEnvironment
      Overrides:
      destroy in class SzCoreEnvironment

    • executeWithBasicRetry

      protected <T> T executeWithBasicRetry(Callable<T> task) throws SzException
      Calls the super class execute(Callable) implementation at least once and then repeatedly if necessary until either the call succeeds, fails with an exception other than SzRetryableException or the configured maximum number of retry attempts has been reached.

      There will be no delay in making the first retry attempt. Subsequent retry attempts will be attempted after an increasing delay with each attempt.

      If still failing with SzRetryableException after the maximum number retries has been reached, then the SzRetryableException is simply re-thrown.

      Type Parameters:
      T - The return type of the specified Callable.
      Parameters:
      task - The task to execute.
      Returns:
      The return value from the specified Callable
      Throws:
      SzRetryableException - If the specified task failed with this exception and we have retried the maximum number of times.
      SzException - If a failure occurs.

    • submitTask

      public <T> Future<T> submitTask(Callable<T> task)
      Performs the specified task using this instance's configured thread pool and internal ExecutorService via ExecutorService.submit(Callable) or directly executes the task in the calling thread if the thread pool has been disabled.

      This returned Future will provide the result of the task via Future.get() upon successful completion.

      NOTE: Any Senzing Core SDK calls made using this SzAutoEnvironment instance will also be run in the same thread with no additional context switching.

      Specified by:
      submitTask in interface SzAutoEnvironment
      Type Parameters:
      T - The return type of the task.
      Parameters:
      task - The Callable task to perform.
      Returns:
      A Future representing the result of the result of the task.

    • submitTask

      public Future<?> submitTask(Runnable task)
      Performs the specified task using this instance's configured thread pool and internal ExecutorService via ExecutorService.submit(Runnable) or directly executes the task in the calling thread if the thread pool has been disabled.

      This returned Future will provide a null value via Future.get() upon successful completion.

      NOTE: Any Senzing Core SDK calls made using this SzAutoEnvironment instance will also be run in the same thread with no additional context switching.

      Specified by:
      submitTask in interface SzAutoEnvironment
      Parameters:
      task - The Runnable task to perform.
      Returns:
      A Future representing the result of the result of the task that will provide the value null upon successful completion.
